messages.subject: Default axis.title.x in theme_bw
parts:
Not sure since when, it looks to me the axis.title.x is now too close
to axis text. The vjust is 1, but for theme_gray it is 0.5.
Please see the attached examples.

Is it possible for the future version to teak the default theme_bw?

library(ggplot2)
qplot(1:10, 1:10) + xlab('This Is a Test')
qplot(1:10, 1:10) + xlab('This Is a Test') + theme_bw()
qplot(1:10, 1:10) + xlab('This Is a Test') + theme_bw() +
opts(axis.title.x = theme_text(size = 12, vjust = 0.5))

Regards,

xiechao

messages.author: 439a20c9d67ff394
messages.subject: Re: Default axis.title.x in theme_bw
parts:
I seem to recall something similar being discussed (with no conclusive
resolution) in an earlier thread:

http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/98af4347774a2015

Everyone else seems to comment on the fact that the axis title text is
very close to the tick mark labels, but to my eye the axis title is
positioned correctly, but the tick mark labels are spaced further away
from the tick marks. (cf compare the OP's theme_bw vs theme_gray
plots). When I've encountered this in my plots, my main issue is that
in theme_bw(), axis.text.x seems unresponsive to setting vjust; their
spacing relative to the tick marks remains the same for vjust set to
0, 0.5 or 1.

-joran
